The Doctrine of the Mean on learning

The Doctrine of the Mean appears in this archive through verified English quotations that touch learning. Education is not only information transfer; it is the shaping of attention and character. Confucian learning, Socratic midwifery, and Deweyan growth offer rival models. Read the passages as entry points, then return to the full thinker and theme pages for wider context.
